messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":1,"verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":21,"text":"He will bring upon thee many severe plagues, and take from thee all that thou hast."},{"chapter":1,"verse":22,"text":"He will take away thine children, and will inflict many evils upon thee."},{"chapter":1,"verse":23,"text":"Then thou must wrestle like an athlete and resist pain, sure of thy reward, overcome trials and afflictions."},{"chapter":1,"verse":24,"text":"But when thou endurest, I shall make thy name renowned throughout all generations of the earth until to the end of the world."},{"chapter":1,"verse":25,"text":"And I shall restore thee to all that thou hadst had, and the double part of what thou shalt lose will be given to thee in order that thou mayest know that God does not consider the person but giveth to each who deserveth the good."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
